reviews.text: Smells really nice and lathers well. Does not dry my skin out.
reviews.zh: 味道好好聞，打泡都好好。唔會令我皮膚乾燥。

reviews.text: Smells and feels great on the skin! The pump is super convenient.
reviews.zh: 香味同用落皮膚嘅感覺都好好！個泵頭超方便。

reviews.text: Good product all in all. I like the smell. I am not sure about moisturizing but that wasn't my goal anyway.
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講係好產品。我鍾意個香味。我唔肯定保濕效果點樣，不過反正我本身都唔係為咗保濕而買。

reviews.text: This body wash has a relaxing scent. The sweet yet fresh note of lavender goes perfectly with the fruity scent of bergamot. Highly recommend!!
reviews.zh: 呢款沐浴露香味好放鬆。薰衣草嘅甜美又清新嘅香氣，同佛手柑嘅果香好夾。極力推薦！！

reviews.text: I got shower gel leaked, super disappointed. When I first open from bag, it’s full of scent and wet.
reviews.zh: 我收到嘅沐浴露有漏液，非常失望。我由袋入面拎出嚟第一次打開嗰陣，成袋都係香味，而且濕晒。

reviews.text: I didn’t like it. The lavender scent is strong however I find it’s very synthetic, and not luxurious. More suitable for hand wash than body.
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意。薰衣草香味好濃，不過我覺得好人工，唔夠高級。比起沖身，更適合用嚟洗手。

reviews.text: The most relaxing shower gel ever. Very luxurious. It leaves you squeaky clean 😍😍😍
reviews.zh: 有史以來最放鬆嘅沐浴露。非常高級。洗完超級乾淨 😍😍😍

reviews.text: Please let me know when it will be restocked. Definitely a must buy product on promo!
reviews.zh: 請話我知幾時會再補貨。減價嗰陣一定係必買產品！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
